posts.text: I just found out the iconic and legendary actor Tim Curry passed away today. I got to take a weekend road trip with Tim and his team (the amazing Marcia, Ramon, and Scott) to San Francisco for the 40th anniversary of the screening of the movie "Clue" a few months ago. Tim was a wonderful guy to be around. He was warm, funny, and full of his acerbic whit. RIP Tim Curry  #timcurry #it #actor #pennywise

posts.text: **RIP Tim Curry** A few months ago I got to take a road trip with Tim Curry from LA to San Francisco for the 40th anniversary of the movie “Clue.” I got to spend time with Tim and his team (Marcia and Ramon) and we had a great weekend. Tim did so good on the trip! It saddens me to find out he passed away today.  I edited this video 2 months ago and hadn’t released it yet, and when I got the news this morning, I knew it was time. ❤️ #timcurry #actor #movie #hollywood
